declaration.preface:
At Alchem International Pvt. Ltd., we recognize that procurement decisions play a critical role in shaping our environmental, social, ethical, and economic impacts. As a responsible organization, we are committed to integrating sustainability principles into our procurement practices and supply chain management processes.

We believe that sustainable procurement extends beyond cost, quality, and delivery considerations. It encompasses responsible sourcing, ethical business conduct, environmental stewardship, human rights protection, supplier diversity, climate action, and long-term value creation for stakeholders.

Through this Sustainable Procurement & Responsible Sourcing Policy, Alchem seeks to promote responsible business practices throughout its value chain by engaging suppliers, contractors, service providers, and business partners who share our commitment to sustainability, integrity, transparency, and continuous improvement.

This policy establishes the principles, commitments, objectives, and governance framework that guide procurement-related decisions and supplier relationships across Alchem's operations.
declaration.declaration:
Responsible Business Conduct: We conduct procurement activities ethically, transparently, and fairly while promoting integrity throughout our supply chain.

Environmental Stewardship: We encourage suppliers to minimize environmental impacts through responsible resource management, pollution prevention, waste reduction, climate action, and biodiversity protection.

Respect for Human Rights: We promote the protection of human rights and expect suppliers to maintain fair labor practices, safe working conditions, and respect for worker dignity.

Sustainable Value Creation: We consider environmental, social, ethical, quality, innovation, resilience, and life-cycle impacts when making procurement decisions.

Supplier Collaboration: We seek to build long-term partnerships with suppliers that support continuous improvement and sustainable business growth.

Transparency & Accountability: We encourage openness, accurate reporting, and responsible disclosure of sustainability-related information throughout the supply chain.

Risk-Based Approach: We proactively identify, assess, and manage environmental, social, ethical, operational, and regulatory risks within our supply chain.
declaration.scope:
This policy applies to:

All employees, workers, contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, and business partners operating at or for BALLABGARH SITE

All activities including manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, administration, product design, research & development, and procurement.

The surrounding communities and ecosystems that may be affected by our operations.

Baseline Year: FY 2023‑24

Target Year: FY 2030‑31

focusAreas: Environmental Sustainability in the Supply Chain

Sustainable Supplier Selection & Evaluat: Integrate sustainability considerations into supplier qualification, selection, and performance evaluation processes.
Assess suppliers based on environmental, social, ethical, quality, operational, and governance criteria.
Promote transparency and accountability in supplier selection decisions.
Encourage suppliers to establish sustainability management systems and performance improvement programs.
Prioritize suppliers demonstrating strong ESG performance and responsible business practices.
Environmental Sustainability in the Supp: Encourage suppliers to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, waste generation, pollution, and resource consumption.
Promote responsible use of energy, water, raw materials, and natural resources.
Support suppliers in implementing environmental management systems and climate-related initiatives.
Encourage adoption of renewable energy, circular economy practices, and environmentally preferable materials.
Minimize environmental impacts across the product life cycle.
Human Rights & Labor Standards in the Su: Promote respect for internationally recognized human rights throughout the supply chain.
Prohibit child labor, forced labor, bonded labor, modern slavery, and human trafficking.
Encourage fair wages, reasonable working hours, freedom of association, and safe working conditions.
Support diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity within supplier operations.
Encourage suppliers to establish grievance mechanisms and worker engagement processes.
Ethical Sourcing & Business Integrity: Promote ethical conduct, integrity, transparency, and accountability throughout procurement activities.
Prevent bribery, corruption, fraud, conflicts of interest, money laundering, and unethical business practices.
Encourage suppliers to maintain effective ethics and compliance programs.
Ensure procurement decisions are made objectively and free from improper influence.
Promote fair competition and responsible business conduct throughout the value chain.
Climate Action & Carbon Management: Encourage suppliers to actively measure, manage, and reduce greenhouse gas emissions associated with their operations, products, and services.
Support the transition toward low-carbon and climate-resilient supply chains.
Promote energy efficiency, renewable energy adoption, and climate-related risk management among suppliers.
Integrate climate considerations into procurement decision-making processes.
Collaborate with suppliers to identify opportunities for reducing supply chain carbon emissions.
Circular Economy & Resource Efficiency: Promote the efficient use of resources throughout the supply chain.
Encourage suppliers to minimize waste generation and maximize reuse, recycling, and recovery opportunities.
Support circular economy principles in product design, packaging, material sourcing, and manufacturing processes.
Reduce dependency on virgin materials through responsible sourcing alternatives.
Encourage sustainable packaging solutions and waste reduction initiatives.

policy.monitoring:
To effectively implement this Sustainable Procurement & Responsible Sourcing Policy, Alchem shall establish a structured and risk-based procurement management framework that integrates sustainability considerations into supplier selection, procurement decisions, supplier performance evaluation, and ongoing supplier engagement activities.

Integrate ESG criteria into supplier onboarding; conduct supplier pre-qualification assessments; evaluate supplier sustainability performance; maintain approved supplier lists; periodically review supplier performance.

Assess supplier environmental performance; encourage ISO 14001 certification; monitor environmental risks; promote renewable energy adoption, waste reduction, resource efficiency, and pollution prevention initiatives.

Conduct labor and human rights assessments; verify compliance with labor laws; review supplier labor practices; monitor high-risk suppliers; implement corrective actions where necessary.

Conduct supplier integrity due diligence; communicate anti-corruption expectations; monitor ethics compliance; investigate reported concerns; promote transparency and accountability.

Engage suppliers on carbon reduction initiatives; encourage GHG emissions reporting; assess climate-related risks; support energy efficiency and renewable energy programs.

Promote sustainable materials sourcing; encourage recyclable and reusable packaging; support waste reduction initiatives; collaborate on circular economy projects.

Identify opportunities for local sourcing; support SMEs and local suppliers; encourage supplier diversity; promote inclusive procurement practices.

Conduct traceability reviews; assess sourcing risks; strengthen transparency within supply chains; maintain responsible sourcing documentation.

Perform supplier risk assessments; maintain supplier risk registers; monitor corrective action plans; review supplier sustainability performance regularly.

Conduct supplier workshops, training sessions, awareness programs, and sustainability engagement activities; share best practices and support performance improvement.
policy.reviewMechanism:
This Ethical & Sustainable Supply chain Policy shall be reviewed annually to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with Alchem's sustainability objectives, regulatory requirements, stakeholder expectations, industry best practices, and emerging supply chain risks.

The review process shall evaluate:

Progress against sustainable procurement objectives and quantitative targets.

Supplier sustainability performance and ESG risk assessments.

Findings from supplier audits, assessments, and compliance reviews.

Corrective actions and supplier improvement initiatives.

Changes in applicable laws, regulations, customer requirements, and sustainability standards.

Emerging environmental, social, ethical, governance, and supply chain risks.

Feedback received from employees, suppliers, customers, auditors, and other stakeholders.

Opportunities to strengthen responsible sourcing practices and supply chain resilience.
